uripok.name: Uripok
uripok.about:
Uripok is a long-settled residential locality in Imphal West district, on the western side of the city centre. It is made up of many small neighbourhoods, or leikais, such as Uripok Polem Leikai, Yambem Leikai, Achom Leikai, Khaidem Leikai, Bachaspati Leikai and Tourangbam Leikai, along with the Naoremthong, Khwai Brahmapur and Sorbon Thingel pockets. The temple of the goddess Laikhurembi here is known for its Lai Haraoba festival.

Iroishemba, Langol and Lamphel lie close by on the same side of the city, so tutors who already teach in those areas can usually add a home in Uripok without difficulty. Because each leikai has its own name, give the tutor both the leikai and a nearby landmark, such as the temple, before the first visit. Most tutors in Imphal travel by two-wheeler or auto, and inner lanes suit a two-wheeler better than a car. During the monsoon, allow extra time and agree a backup online session for days of heavy rain. Families can ask for a tutor who knows the Manipur board pattern or CBSE. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

thangmeiband.name: Thangmeiband
thangmeiband.about:
Thangmeiband is a large residential area of Imphal West, home to around fifty thousand people. It covers neighbourhoods such as Sinam Leikai, Yumnam Leikai, Maisnam Leikai, Hijam Leikai, Hijam Dewan Leikai and Polem Leikai, and it also takes in a college campus area, Lalambung Makhong, Guigailong, Khomdram Selungba and Langol Tarung on its edges. Parts of the busy Thangal Bazar trading area fall within the same block of neighbourhoods.

Thangmeiband is also known for its schools, so many families here look for help with Class 10 and Class 12 preparation. Its central position means tutors can reach it from Uripok, Langol, Lamphel and the Thangal side. Homes range across many named lanes, so share the leikai name and a clear landmark with the tutor. Roads towards the market area are busiest in the late afternoon, so a fixed early-evening slot is easier to keep. For students preparing for the Board of Secondary Education, Manipur or the Class 11 to 12 council exams, ask for a tutor familiar with that pattern. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

langol.name: Langol
langol.about:
Langol is a residential area on the western side of Imphal, in Imphal West district. Its neighbourhoods include Langol Lairembi Leikai, Langol Aying Leikai and Langol Ningthou, which are grouped with Uripok, Iroishemba and Lamphel, while Langol Tarung lies on the Thangmeiband side.

For a home tutor, Langol is easiest with someone already teaching in Uripok, Thangmeiband or Lamphel, since all of these sit on the same side of the city. Tell the tutor which part of Langol you live in, because the name covers several separate neighbourhoods, and share a phone number for the first visit. Tutors usually come by two-wheeler or auto. In heavy rain, some routes take longer, so agree in advance whether a class can move online on those days rather than being cancelled. Online classes are also a sensible choice for less common subjects or for senior-secondary specialist help. Ask for a tutor who knows the Manipur state board pattern if your child is in a state board school, or CBSE where that applies. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

lamphel.name: Lamphel and Lamphelpat
lamphel.about:
Lamphelpat is the administrative headquarters of Imphal West district and is often described as a suburb of Imphal. The name joins Lamphel, a place name in the city, with pat, the Meitei word for a lake. Government offices sit alongside homes here, and the Lamphel Sana Keithel market area is part of the same cluster of neighbourhoods as Uripok, Iroishemba and Langol.

Because Lamphelpat is an office area as well as a residential one, traffic builds around office opening and closing times, so after-school slots that start once offices close are usually smoother. Families in the residential pockets near the market can ask for a tutor from Uripok, Langol or Thangmeiband. Most tutors travel by two-wheeler or auto. Where a home is inside a campus or a building with a gate, tell the guard the tutor's name in advance. Online classes help when the right specialist subject teacher lives on the eastern side of the city. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sagolband.name: Sagolband
sagolband.about:
Sagolband is a central residential area of Imphal West district, made up of many leikais and lanes. Its neighbourhoods include Sagolband Tera, Bijoy Govinda, Thangjam Leikai, Ingudam Leikai, Thingom Leikai, Takhellambam Leikai, Kangabam Leikai, Salam Leikai, Moirang Leirak and Meino Leirak, and the same cluster takes in Sayang Pukhri Mapal, Kakhulong, Old Lambulane and part of Paona Bazar.

Keishampat and Kwakeithel adjoin it and the central market area is close by, so tutors from across the city centre can reach it easily. With so many named lanes, a precise address matters: give the leikai, the lane name and a landmark. Homes near Paona Bazar are close to busy shopping streets, so the evening rush is worth avoiding when choosing a class time. Tutors mostly come by two-wheeler or auto. Families following the Manipur state board or CBSE can ask for a tutor who knows the right syllabus. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

keishampat.name: Keishampat
keishampat.about:
Keishampat is a residential locality in Imphal West district. Its neighbourhoods include Keishampat Mutum Leikai, Thiyam Leikai, Leimajam Leikai, Thokchom Leikai, Lairembi Lampak and the Sega Road area. Keishamthong, Elangbam Leikai, Huidrom Leikai, Moirang Purel Leikai and Kwakeithel are grouped with it, and parts of Sagolband adjoin it.

This compact cluster of neighbourhoods suits home tuition well, because a tutor living in Keishampat, Kwakeithel or Sagolband can reach most homes here easily. When booking, give the leikai name and a nearby landmark, since several neighbourhoods share similar names. Tutors generally travel by two-wheeler or auto, and the narrower lanes are easier on two wheels. Plan around the late-afternoon rush on roads leading to the city centre, and in the monsoon keep a backup online slot. Ask for a tutor familiar with the Board of Secondary Education, Manipur for Class 10, or CBSE where that applies. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

kwakeithel.name: Kwakeithel
kwakeithel.about:
Kwakeithel is a residential locality in Imphal West, grouped with Keishampat and Keishamthong. Its neighbourhoods include Kwakeithel Thokchom Leikai, Kwakeithel Akham Leikai, Kwakeithel Nganapi Thong Mapal and Kwakeithel Thounaojam Leikai, with Irom Pukhri Mapal and Khagempalli Panthak close by.

Because it borders both Keishampat and Sagolband, families in Kwakeithel can draw on tutors who live across this southern-central belt of the city. Share the exact leikai with the tutor, as the locality is spread over several parts. Most tutors come by two-wheeler or auto; give a phone number for the first visit so the tutor can call from the main road. Traffic on routes towards the city centre is heaviest in the late afternoon, so an early-evening class that starts after school traffic eases tends to run on time. During heavy monsoon rain, switching a class online for the day keeps the routine going. Online sessions also suit specialist subjects in Classes 11 and 12. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

singjamei.name: Singjamei
singjamei.about:
Singjamei is a residential area of Imphal West district, close to the boundary with Imphal East. Its neighbourhoods include Singjamei Chirom Leikai, Top Leikai, Sapam Leikai, Mayengbam Leikai, Leishangthem Leikai, Thongam Leikai, Waikhom Leikai, Okram Leikai and Oinam Thingel, and it is grouped with Chingamakha, Chingamathak, Yumnam Leikai and Thokchom Leikai. Singjamei Wangma lies across the boundary on the Imphal East side.

For home tuition, Singjamei and Chingamakha form one natural catchment, so a tutor who lives in either can usually take on regular visits in both. Keishampat and Kwakeithel are also within easy reach. Give the tutor the leikai name, the mapal or lane, and a landmark, because many parts of Singjamei carry family names that sound alike. Tutors mostly travel by two-wheeler or auto. Avoid the busiest late-afternoon period for the first demo, and agree how classes will run on days of heavy rain, with online sessions as the fallback. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

thangal-bazar.name: Thangal Bazar and Paona Bazar
thangal-bazar.about:
Thangal Bazar is the central trading area of Imphal, just west of Kangla Fort. The Ima Keithel, the women-run market in the Khwairamband Bazaar complex with its pagoda-style roofed buildings, stands on the main road through Thangal Bazar. Paona Bazar lies alongside it, and both areas have homes on the lanes behind the shopfronts, linked to Thangmeiband, Sagolband and Old Lambulane.

Kangla Fort, the old royal seat on the western bank of the Imphal River, is the main landmark for directions. For tutors, the market streets are the busiest roads in the city during shopping hours, so classes in homes here run more smoothly in the early morning on weekends or in the evening after shops quieten. Two-wheelers are far easier than cars for parking. Families can draw on tutors from Thangmeiband, Sagolband and Keishampat, and online classes are practical when traffic or weather gets in the way. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

wangkhei.name: Wangkhei
wangkhei.about:
Wangkhei is a residential area on the eastern side of the Imphal River, in Imphal East district. Its neighbourhoods include Wangkhei Angom Leikai, Wangkheirakpam Leikai, Konsam Leikai, Thangjam Leikai, Tokpam Leikai, Ningthem Pukhri Mapal and Thangapat Mapal, with Moirangkhom, Brahmapur and Rajbari grouped with it on one side and Mantri Pukhri, Chingmeirong, Kabo Leikai and parts of Khurai on the other.

The Shree Govindajee Temple beside the old palace grounds lies in the same part of Imphal East, and the riverside walk on the eastern bank is a well-known landmark for directions. Families here can find tutors from Khurai, Chingmeirong and Yaiskul as well as from across the river. Most tutors travel by two-wheeler or auto, crossing the river by the central bridges, which get busy in the late afternoon. Give the leikai and mapal name with a landmark for the first visit, and keep online classes for specialist subjects or rainy days. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

khurai.name: Khurai
khurai.about:
Khurai is a large residential area in Imphal East district, on the eastern side of the city. It is divided into many leikais, including Khurai Konsam Leikai, Thongam Leikai, Thoidingjam Leikai, Sajor Leikai, Puthiba Leikai, Nandeibam Leikai, Laishram Leikai, Kongkham Leikai, Chingangbam Leikai and Khongnangmakhong, with Kongpal, Ningthoubung, Khomidok, Khabeisoi and Sangomsang nearby.

The western parts of Khurai adjoin Wangkhei, and several Khurai neighbourhoods sit in the same block as Chingmeirong and Mantri Pukhri, so tutors from the Wangkhei side can often reach homes here. Because Khurai covers so many separate leikais, give the tutor the exact leikai and a nearby landmark, along with a phone number for the first visit. Most tutors travel by two-wheeler or auto. Routes towards the river crossings and the city centre are busiest in the late afternoon, so an early-evening slot with a tutor from the eastern side is the most practical choice. Online classes help with specialist senior-secondary subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

porompat.name: Porompat
porompat.about:
Porompat is a census town on the eastern side of Imphal and the headquarters of Imphal East district, which was formed in 1997. The 2011 census counted a little over six thousand residents. District offices stand here alongside homes, and Porompat is grouped with neighbouring areas such as Kongba Laishram Leikai, Gangapat, Naharup, Makhapat, Thangbrijou and Bamon Kampu.

As an office area, Porompat is busiest around office opening and closing times, so after-school classes that begin once offices close usually start on time. Tutors living in Porompat, Kongba or Khurai are well placed for regular visits, and those from Wangkhei can also reach the area. Most tutors come by two-wheeler or auto. Give the neighbourhood name and a clear landmark for the first visit. For Classes 11 and 12, where the right subject specialist may live across the city, online classes are a practical option. Ask for a tutor familiar with the Manipur state board pattern or CBSE, as needed. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

chingmeirong.name: Chingmeirong
chingmeirong.about:
Chingmeirong is a residential area of Imphal East, divided into Chingmeirong Nongchup and Chingmeirong Nongpok. It is grouped with Mantri Pukhri, Kabo Leikai, Golapati, Nongpok Ingkhol, New Checkon and Wangkheirakpam Leikai, and parts of Khurai lie close by. Several schools are located in Chingmeirong.

With schools in and around the area, families here often need help with board-year preparation as well as regular homework support. Tutors living in Mantri Pukhri, Wangkhei or Khurai can usually reach Chingmeirong easily. Tell the tutor whether you are in the Nongchup or Nongpok part, and give a landmark and phone number for the first visit. Most tutors travel by two-wheeler or auto. School traffic around the area peaks at opening and closing times, so set class times outside those periods, and use online sessions when weather or distance makes regular visits difficult. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Uripok, Thangmeiband & Lamphel.fact: Lamphelpat is the administrative headquarters of Imphal West district; the name combines the place name Lamphel with pat, the Meitei word for a lake.
Imphal West district has four sub-divisions: Lamphelpat, Patsoi, Lamsang and Wangoi.
Imphal West was the most populous district of Manipur at the 2011 census, with 517,992 residents.
Uripok is a census town in Imphal West district with a temple of the goddess Laikhurembi, where the Lai Haraoba festival is held.
The Uripok constituency area, created in 1967, includes Iroishemba, Langol, Lamphel Sana Keithel, Naoremthong and Khwai Brahmapur.
Thangmeiband, created as a constituency area in 1972, includes Langol Tarung, Lalambung Makhong and parts of Thangal Bazar.

Sagolband, Keishampat & Singjamei.fact: The Ima Keithel occupies the Khwairamband Bazaar complex, west of Kangla Fort in the Thangal Bazar locality, in three buildings with pagoda-style roofs.
Kangla Fort, the old capital of pre-modern Manipur, now remains on the western bank of the Imphal River and is managed by the Kangla Fort Board.
The Nambul River flows through the heart of Imphal and once linked southern and eastern villages with the Khwairamband market by water.
The Sagolband area takes in Sagolband Tera, Bijoy Govinda, Kakhulong, Old Lambulane and part of Paona Bazar.
Keishampat, Keishamthong, Elangbam Leikai, Kwakeithel, Huidrom Leikai and Moirang Purel Leikai are grouped together in Imphal West.
Singjamei in Imphal West is grouped with Chingamakha and Chingamathak.

Wangkhei, Khurai & Porompat.fact: Porompat is the headquarters of Imphal East district, which was formed in June 1997 by dividing the original Imphal district.
Porompat is a census town with 6,191 residents at the 2011 census.
Since the 2007 delimitation, the Wangkhei constituency area covers Ward Nos. 21, 22, 23 and 26 of Imphal municipality, including Mantri Pukhri, Chingmeirong and Kabo Leikai.
Khurai in Imphal East is made up of many leikais, including Konsam Leikai, Thoidingjam Leikai, Kongkham Leikai and Chingangbam Leikai, with Khomidok, Sangomsang and Ningthoubung nearby.
The Shree Govindajee Temple in Imphal East stands next to Sana Konung, the former royal palace.
Kangla Nongpok Torban, a riverside recreation area on the eastern bank of the Imphal River from Sanjenthong Bridge northwards, was developed under Imphal Smart City Limited.
